content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

What share of group revenue year to date is earned in each currency?

content.statement:
WITH __pnl AS (
  SELECT
    fiscal_year,
    group_line,
    local_currency,
    row_type,
    year_month,
    amount_inr
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_AGENT_PNL
)
SELECT
  local_currency,
  SUM(IFF(group_line = 'REVENUE', amount_inr, 0)) AS revenue_inr,
  RATIO_TO_REPORT(SUM(IFF(group_line = 'REVENUE', amount_inr, 0))) OVER () * 100 AS share_of_revenue_pct
FROM __pnl
WHERE
  fiscal_year = 2026 AND MONTH(year_month) <= 7 AND row_type = 'ENTITY'
GROUP BY
  local_currency
ORDER BY
  revenue_inr DESC
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: f6613bff-6608-4d8f-a999-0f25f75e28b4)
;
